create.name: Claire Creighton
create.bio:
Claire Creighton is a shamanic practitioner, oracle and teacher of intuitive development based in Cape Town, South Africa, where she was born. Her family roots run through Malta, Greece, Romania, Ireland and Egypt, and that sense of ancestry shapes much of her work. She trained in London in shamanic healing, psychic development and mediumship, studying at the College of Psychic Studies among other schools, and she also qualified in EFT and in conscious connected breathwork. Much of the rest, she says, she has learned by doing.

Her work centres on soul retrieval, inner child work and intuitive guidance, which she frames as helping people remember who they are beneath their conditioning. She sees a small number of private clients, often over several months, and holds soul retrieval sessions and seasonal ceremonies in person in Cape Town. Online she runs live classes in psychic development and channelling, and has trained a circle of certified intuitive guide practitioners. Her self-paced courses cover the psychic senses, shamanic journeying with a power animal and a ten-day series of heart-centred meditations, and she shares drum journeys, oracle readings and talks on Insight Timer and YouTube.

courses.title: Foundations of Psychic Development & Intuition
courses.description: A self-paced beginners' course of thirteen video lessons, hosted on Udemy, on how psychic perception works and how to find your strongest intuitive sense. Lessons move through psychometry, scrying, the chakras, third-eye practices and keeping your energy grounded and clear.

courses.title: Shamanic Journey to the Lower World
courses.description: A ten-day audio course introducing the shamanic journey: crossing into the lower world, meeting a power animal and learning to tell imagination from genuine contact. Later sessions cover personal power, ritual, and the spirits of fire and earth.

courses.title: A Mystical Surrender to the Heart
courses.description: Ten days of short talks, each followed by a guided meditation of about ten minutes, on themes such as letting go, courage, forgiveness, gratitude and joy. The journeys bring in a heart angel, the inner child, Mother Earth and a power animal.

courses.title: Intuitive Life Coaching
courses.description: Online one-to-one sessions of an hour, held weekly or fortnightly over at least six meetings, in which Claire uses her intuition and shamanic training to look at patterns around relationships, work, money and direction. Each session ends with practical homework. Her private diary is currently full, with a waiting list.

courses.title: Soul Retrieval
courses.description: Long in-person shamanic sessions in Cape Town, lasting between ninety minutes and three hours, with preparation beforehand and integration work afterwards. Power retrieval and ancestral work may also come up within a session.

courses.title: Inner Child Healing
courses.description: Online private sessions of roughly ninety minutes to two hours, guided by Claire's intuitive and shamanic experience, that meet and reconnect with the younger self. The aim is to work with long-held patterns gently and in a single sitting.

free_resources.title: Claire Creighton on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Claire's Insight Timer page has shamanic drum journeys, breathwork, psychic development practices and heart-centred meditations, all free to listen to.
